decisions.statement: A joint's mobility reads as a direction from its first numbered reading to its last.
A higher number is farther, whatever the metric.
A metric read on one side is answered apart from that metric on the other side.
A reading with no number takes no part in a direction.
A metric with fewer than two numbered readings has no direction yet.
Every metric with a reading is answered, in the order the metrics are named.
Every answer here is built by a function rather than written out as a value.

definition: how far each joint moved, and which way that is going
